summary.headline: Strong pages, *a weak signal off the site.* AI tools can read you; few of them name you.
summary.lede: A fictional sample. The site is well built and well written, but other sites rarely mention it, and that is what AI assistants lean on.
paragraphs: Harbour & Pine scores **61 out of 100**, in the Needs Work band. The technical base is solid: every page loads in raw HTML, Bing and Google both index the site, and no AI search bot is blocked.
The most urgent issue is the **stale Brave index**, which still shows the 2024 team page. Claude reads Brave, so Claude describes a firm that no longer exists.
The biggest opportunity is the firm's own data: 140 client engagements with before-and-after numbers that never appear on the site.
topFixes: Redirect the five retired /team/* URLs and request a Brave recrawl.
Add a 40–60 word answer under the H1 of each of the six service pages.
Publish the engagement data as a research page with method and sample size.
summary.strength: Every service page names a real client and a measured result, which is rare for the category.
